# RE2JS

`re2js.js` is the ESM distribution of RE2JS 2.10.0, downloaded from the
npm package `re2js@2.10.0` (https://github.com/le0pard/re2js). It is
unmodified and distributed under the MIT license in `RE2JS-LICENSE.txt`.
RE2 syntax deliberately excludes some JavaScript features, such as lookahead
and backreferences.
